prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury attorney in Chicago for a car accident claim?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” personal injury lawyer for every car-accident case — the right attorney depends on the facts of your crash, your injuries, whether the case will likely settle or go to trial, and personal fit. I can help you find the best lawyer for your situation. Below are practical steps, what to look for, and a few reputable places to search.

How to choose the right attorney
- Experience with car-accident cases: look for an attorney or firm that handles car-crash/personal-injury work daily. Experience with cases like yours (catastrophic injury, whiplash, multiple-vehicle, uninsured motorist, hit-and-run) matters.
- Trial experience: many cases settle, but trial experience is crucial if the insurer refuses fair offers.
- Track record: past settlements/verdicts give a sense of capability (every case differs, so results aren’t guarantees).
- Resources: firms that can hire accident reconstructionists, medical experts, and investigators are better for complex claims.
- Communication and accessibility: you want someone who returns calls, explains options, and keeps you updated.
- Fee structure and costs: most work on contingency (no fee unless you recover); clarify percentage, who advances case costs, and how medical liens are handled.
- Local knowledge: familiarity with Chicago courts, local judges, hospitals, and treating providers helps.
- Reviews and peer recognition: look at client reviews, AV ratings (Martindale-Hubbell), Super Lawyers lists, and local bar endorsements.

Questions to ask at a free consultation
- How many car-accident cases have you handled? How many went to trial?
- Who will handle my case day to day?
- What is your assessment of my claim and likely value range?
- What are your fees and who pays costs upfront?
- How do you handle medical liens and bills?
- How long do cases like mine usually take?
- Can you provide references or case results?

Where to look for reputable Chicago personal-injury lawyers
- Chicago Bar Association / Cook County Bar directories
- Illinois State Bar Association referral service
- Super Lawyers (Chicago listing)
- Martindale-Hubbell (peer-reviewed ratings)
- Avvo or Google client reviews

Well-known Chicago firms (examples, not endorsements)
- Clifford Law Offices
- Levin & Perconti
- Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard (Salvi & Maher)
- Power Rogers & Smith
(These are widely recognized for serious personal-injury work; this is not a ranked or exhaustive list.)

Practical notes
- Illinois statute of limitations for personal-injury claims is generally 2 years from the date of the accident — act promptly to preserve your rights.
- Preserve evidence: police report, photos, medical records, witness info, and any vehicle damage notes.
- If you have urgent medical bills or ongoing treatment, tell any attorney you consult so they can advise about medical providers and liens.

If you want, tell me:
- your zip code,
- a short summary of the crash and injuries,
- whether you’ve talked to an insurance company,
and I’ll prepare a short list of highly rated Chicago attorneys who fit your needs and instructions for contacting them.
